page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; running head at top centre; page number at top right; marginal notes in the left margin beside the paragraph beginning "Non fruftrà".

main_text.p: qui vltimus hanc historiam conscripsit, & qui propius singula dicta factaque obseruauit, tectis nimirum oculatus ex diuina prouidentia, copiosius & specialius haec perlequutus est, atque, sententiam hanc solenniter pronunciatam fuisse, & quidem pro tribunali ex more, loco nimirum huiusmodi negotiis destinato, quem propterea Graece λιθόστρωτον, & lingua populari, Gabbatha, id est folium magnificae alicuius & eminentis structurae, nominat.

Vsus huius excel-lentis doctrinae.Non fruftrà autem id factum est: nolente nimirum Patre Filium mori nec Iudaeorum infidiis, nec per tumultum, nec clanculum: sed publicè in omnium oculis & aspectu, forma iuridica, quantumuis hominum respectu iniqua: quasi nimirum coelitus Deus ab Oriente ad Occidentem, & à Meridie ad Septentrionem, vt postea per Euangelij praedicationem contigit, coelitus haec verba detonasset, Infelices homines, intuemini in hoc vnico meo Filio, quem super hoc theatrum taquam vadem & sponsorem vestrum propono, hinc quidem quantus sit meus aduersus peccatum furor, & quid sitis ipsi promeriti: inde vero quàm immensa mea & illius misericordia erga omnes hanc gratiam amplexantes. Agite igitur, fratres, discamus hanc historiam meditari, discamus, inquam, non velut per transennam summa tantum in genere capita meditari, sed singulas eius circunstantias expendere: quandoquidem ista nobis tam accurate coposeque concinnata

page.notes: The left margin note is printed as "Vsus huius excel-lentis doctrinae." in three lines; the catchword "concri-" at the foot right is a line-end fragment and is read as "concinnata" continuation; the text at the lower right reads "concri-" as printed. Certain words in the lower lines are partly illegible due to damage and were read with best effort.
